title: Nexus CoreServiceStopRequest
description: Closed v1 instance-bound stop request for the runtime stop endpoint. A mismatch on instance id or engine epoch returns conflict and performs no stop; no PID-only stop exists.

expected_instance_id.description: Instance identity from discovery; stop is refused when it no longer owns the service.

expected_engine_epoch.description: Engine epoch expected by the caller; null matches an uninitialized service. Mismatch returns conflict.
